title: Silver Rate Is (Almost) Optimal for Gradient Descent Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2609.09152v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how far gradient descent (GD) can be accelerated by predetermined nonnegative stepsizes in smooth convex optimization. Writing $p_{\mathrm{sil}}=\log_2(1+\sqrt{2})$, we prove an $\Omega\left(n^{-p_{\mathrm{sil}}-O(\sqrt{\log\log n/\log n})}\right)$ non-anytime lower bound. In the anytime setting, every infinite nonnegative schedule has infinitely many horizons with error $\Omega\left(n^{-\frac{2p_{\mathrm{sil}}}{1+p_{\mathrm{sil}}}-O(\sqrt{\log\log n/\log n})}\right)$. Together with the silver-schedule upper bound [Altschuler and Parrilo, 2025] and the anytime upper bound [Zhang et al., 2025], our results determine the optimal polynomial convergence exponents in both settings.

translated_title: 银速率对梯度下降加速是（几乎）最优的
translated_abstract: 我们研究在光滑凸优化中，通过预先确定的非负步长，梯度下降（GD）能够被加速到何种程度。记 $p_{\mathrm{sil}}=\log_2(1+\sqrt{2})$，我们证明了 $\Omega\left(n^{-p_{\mathrm{sil}}-O(\sqrt{\log\log n/\log n})}\right)$ 的非anytime下界。在anytime设定下，每一个无限的非负步长调度都存在无穷多个终止时刻，其误差为 $\Omega\left(n^{-\frac{2p_{\mathrm{sil}}}{1+p_{\mathrm{sil}}}-O(\sqrt{\log\log n/\log n})}\right)$。结合银调度的上界 [Altschuler and Parrilo, 2025] 与anytime上界 [Zhang et al., 2025]，我们的结果确定了这两种设定下的最优多项式收敛指数。
tldr: 本文证明了银速率指数是梯度下降加速的最优多项式收敛速率，通过建立非anytime与anytime两种设定下匹配的下界，结合已有上界完整刻画了预定非负步长所能达到的最优加速效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the silver rate exponent is (almost) optimal for gradient descent acceleration, establishing lower bounds in both anytime and non-anytime settings that, together with existing upper bounds, determine the optimal polynomial convergence exponents achievable by predetermined nonnegative stepsizes.
